title: Angel Paradise Vol. 1: Sakaki Yuko: Koi no Yokan in Hollywood
native_title: エンジェルパラダイスボリューム１ 「坂木優子」 ～恋の予感 イン ホリウッド～
overview: Angel Paradise Vol.1: Sakaki Yūko: Koi no Yokan in Hollywood is a puzzle game featuring live-action video clips of gravure model Yuko Sakaki. There are two types of puzzles: jigsaw puzzles where the player must pick up and place pieces in the correct place to fill in portions of the video, and sliding-tile puzzles where a certain portion of the video must be correctly arranged. The main story mode is presented as the four days of a travelogue visiting Hollywood, California; each day includes two video puzzles of each type, plus a "bonus stage" which consists of an extra video of photo of Sakaki. There is also a data room mode where one can read various personal facts about her, and the options menu also lets the player peruse any completed videos and photos.
